created.description: Token issuance or creation time in ISO 8601.

encryption-key-length.description: Encryption key length in bits, when reported.

kerberos-flags.description: Kerberos ticket flags in the source's hexadecimal or decimal bitmask notation; only for a Kerberos token.

modified.description: Last token metadata update time in ISO 8601.

tenant-id.description: Tenant owning the token or defining its authorization scope.

token-id.description: Non-secret token or key identifier, such as a secret ID or token ID; exclude bearer values and client secrets.

type.description: Token kind; preserve distinctions between API or client tokens and Kerberos, OIDC, or SAML tokens.

zone.description: Authorized network zone or geographic restriction reported by the source.

description: Metadata identifying an authentication or API token, including type, tenant, lifetime and optional Kerberos properties. Records identifiers rather than reusable token values. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/token, https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/authentication_token.
name: authentication-token
